items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled out after concussion evaluation mid-game vs Rams following earlier thigh injury and return; also confirmed by Rapoport.
items.why: Concussion evaluation after hit; previously Q to return with thigh.
items.implication: Zero remaining production in TNF game; Packers WR depth elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for other GB WRs in remaining snaps.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday Night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson to start for third straight game. Rapoport aligned.
items.why: Groin not ready on short week after prior misses.
items.implication: Full handcuff/backup elevation in high-scoring potential matchup; Walker ROS monitor.
items.opportunity: Primary carries and likely goal-line to backup RB; snap share expansion.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury from Sunday night vs Vikings; day-to-day per reports.
items.why: Ankle sprain suffered prior game; no practice Wednesday.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 12 availability; potential backup QB implications if misses.
items.opportunity: If out, SF skill players face reduced efficiency; handcuff QB stream.

items.text: Micah Parsons officially active for Packers debut vs Rams after PUP activation and clearance; Rapoport confirmed.
items.why: Cleared post-ACL, activated, on field for TNF Eve.
items.implication: GB defense upgrade; potential snap count limit but pass-rush impact.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC higher PPG among RBs; now faces Carolina.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; prioritize in lineups.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry expectation vs weak run D.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec) in 2 games with Brissett vs under 6%/1.3 earlier; raises PPR floor significantly.
items.implication: Safer RB1/2 PPR start; volume floor elevated.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share Week 11 vs PIT; season 36% avg, 50% end-zone targets; role elite despite injury-impacted production.
items.why: Massive target dominance when healthy/Hurts available.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview notes Tuten injury resurfaces in loss; Schefter/others confirm DNP Wednesday with ankle/foot, questionable trending, re-aggravated prior issue.
items.why: Re-aggravated ankle/foot late in Week 11; DNP Wed, coach priority on health.
items.implication: Game-time or rest risk vs Titans; backup RB (Rodriguez) surge potential.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, full backfield opportunity and carries for next man up.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview: Puka Nacua out for the season (MCL surgery confirmed earlier, 4-5 month timeline).
items.implication: Zero ROS value; Rams WR hierarchy permanent shift (Adams/others elevated).
items.opportunity: Full-season target/route share increase for remaining LAR WRs.

items.text: Berry has Bo Nix on HATE list this week, outside top 20; expects heavy Jonah Coleman run game vs PIT and insufficient Nix rushing upside.
items.why: Run-heavy script likely; limited rushing production observed.
items.implication: Sit/stream elsewhere; QB2 downside in tough spot.

items.text: Levitan on Etienne: could see disappointing snaps and routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17 playoff schedule. Cites Graziano context.
items.why: Snaps/routes likely limited but volume carries sustain floor; schedule boost late.
items.implication: RB2/flex with carry floor over pure receiving upside; hold for playoffs.
items.opportunity: Carry share priority over routes; monitor NO backfield roles.

items.text: Since Rico Dowdle return Week 6, Jaylen Warren only 51% of PIT rush attempts, under 10% targets in 3/5 games; mid-to-low RB2 now (utilization RB20).
items.why: Split backfield with Dowdle reducing share.

items.text: With Kyle Monangai back Week 11, D'Andre Swift 47% snaps, 39% rush attempts, under 10% targets in 4/5 active Monangai games; mid-low RB2.
Ladd McConkey return: season-high 38% target share last week, 20.7 FP; when >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG (if healthy).
items.why: High share on limited healthy snaps.
items.implication: Solid WR2/flex if stays healthy; monitor Herbert status.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share when active >50% snaps.
